attrs.note: datasheet - the material, the finish, the standards (c(UL)us, RoHS, EIA 310.E) and the four #12-24 screws supplied are the specification sheet's; "Color: Black" is the product page's.

cable-capacity.note: datasheet - Leviton's application note "Maximum Cable Fill Ratios in Cable Managers" (NS-AN-23-006-05-30-23, 5/30/2023), page 14: "Ring size: 4.8 sq.in. (49253-2CM, 49254-BCM)", and for the 6AS10 patch cord (0.240 in) 53 cords at 50 percent fill, 31 at 30 percent, 26 at 25 percent. It states 30 percent as the "recommended practical maximum" for patch cords in front managers. The count is a ring's: each of the five has the same opening. It names the cord by Leviton part number and not by category, so no `cable-capacity-media` is stated.

chassis.note: drawing - 444.5 x 88.1 x 63.5. The plate is flat over the whole 19.00 in [482.6mm] and its top and bottom edges fold back from 0.75 in [19.05mm] inside each end to 17.5 in [463.55mm], so the flat ends outside the folds are the ears, which this library does not draw, and the body is the 444.5. Overall depth is 2.50 in [63.5mm]: the rings 2.00 in [50.8mm] from the face of the plate, the sheet 1.5 and the fold 11.2 behind it.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black" and "black powder-coat finish". The drawing is line work and the product images were not used, so the shade is this library's render of black.

cover.note: drawing - the 49253-2CV cover is a separate part sold separately (specification sheet: "Covers are available (sold separately)"), so the manager is drawn without it; the `with-cover` configuration fits it. The instruction sheet, step 3, says to align the cover's sides to the outside split rings and slide it down until fully seated. Nothing says the cover is hinged. No document says the 2RU cover fits the 2 in rings: the 2CV is the cover Leviton lists for 2RU managers.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The ears are the flat ends of the panel, so the ear plane is the panel, and its back face is the one that meets the rail: the top view of the 49253-2CM dimensional drawing dimensions the plate's front face 50.8 mm [2.00 in] behind the ring tips and the sheet 1.5 mm, so `at` is 52.3. Of the 63.5 depth, 11.2 stands behind the rail. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front view: the plate between the folds and the five rings on it, at the other 49253 managers' positions (centred 26.1 mm from the left end of the 482.6 and 107.6 apart), each 76.2 mm high and centred on the 88.1 plate (5.95 above and below). Leviton's mark, printed on the plate near the right ring, is not drawn: a vendor mark never is.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the rings stand 50.8 mm in front of the panel and its folded edges reach only 11.2 behind it (the side view), so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part.

guides.note: drawing - the five rings are the guides: each a component with a `ring` guide (see its contract), cables passing along the panel through each in turn. The opening is 69.85 x 31.75 mm, 3.4 sq in on the drawing; the application note gives 4.8 sq in.

left.note: drawing - an elevation, the drawing's side view: the folded edges behind the plate and the ring's profile in front of it. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DIMENSIONAL DRAWING. Leviton publishes the 49253-2CM drawing as DXF and DWG on its product page; the DXF is vector CAD in inches with five views, and its dimensions read 19.00 in, 3.47 in, 2.0 in, 1.5 in and 2.5 in. Every figure here is read from its line work at 25.4 mm to the inch and agrees with those dimensions and with the specification sheet's page 2 (482.6, 88.1, 50.8 and 63.5 mm). It is the 49253-BCM with 50.8 mm less depth between the back leg and the front legs.

rear.note: drawing - the rear view: the back of the plate, plain, with ten round holes 4.58 mm across, two behind each ring's middle 52.3 mm apart, and the folded edges end-on.

rings.note: drawing - the side view of a ring and the front view of five: see the contract. THE APPLICATION NOTE AND THE DRAWING DISAGREE on this ring's usable depth: page 10 gives 2.75 x 1.75 in (4.8 sq in) and the drawing's clear depth between the back leg and the inner leg is 1.25 in, 12.7 mm less; the drawing is taken, and the note's figure is the one the capacity below counts. The specification sheet's page 2 also labels the drawing's 1.5 in dimension "38.1 mm [1.5]", which agrees.

thickness.note: drawing - 1.5 mm, the plate's two faces 50.8 and 52.3 mm from the front in the top view; "16-gauge steel" on the specification sheet.

top.note: drawing - an elevation, rear at the top of the drawing: the folded edge behind the plate and the five rings' top bars from above, with each bottom bar's last 12.7 mm showing beyond the top bar's end. The bottom is the same from underneath, where each ring's bottom bar runs its full length.

weight.note: no document states a weight: the specification sheet, the product page and the instruction sheet are silent. `weight-kg` is left out and a gap says so.
